Class RuntimeDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.RuntimeDispatch
@Internal public final class RuntimeDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of JVM runtime operations: gc and exit requests, reflection, direct buffers, serialization, class loading and definition, resources, native libraries, zip, JNDI and JMX.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

    • beforeClassLoad

      public void beforeClassLoad(@Nullable ClassLoader loader, String className) throws Throwable
      Called before ClassLoader.loadClass(String) to apply scenarios targeting class loading.
      Parameters:
      loader - the loader performing the lookup; null for the bootstrap loader
      className - the binary name of the class being loaded
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

    • afterResourceLookup

      public @Nullable URL afterResourceLookup(@Nullable ClassLoader loader, String name, @Nullable URL currentValue) throws Throwable
      Called after ClassLoader.getResource(String) to optionally substitute the returned URL.
      Parameters:
      loader - the loader that performed the lookup; null for the bootstrap loader
      name - the resource name that was requested
      currentValue - the URL resolved by the real lookup; may be null
      Returns:
      the (possibly substituted) URL to return to the caller
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

    • beforeGcRequest

      public boolean beforeGcRequest() throws Throwable
      Called before System.gc(); returns true to suppress the GC request.
      Returns:
      true to suppress the real System.gc() call, false to let it proceed
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

      public void beforeJmxInvoke(Object server, Object objectName, String operationName) throws Throwable
      Called before MBeanServer.invoke(...) to apply JMX invoke scenarios. The agent's own MBeans (com.macstab.chaos.jvm) are never a target (L3).

      Throws:

      Called before MBeanServer.getAttribute(...) and getAttributes(...) to apply JMX attribute-read scenarios. The agent's own MBeans (com.macstab.chaos.jvm) are never a target (L3).
